items.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU sovereignty
items.summary: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

items.title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
items.summary: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions.

items.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
items.summary: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak.

items.title: Crypto longs lose $404 million in four hours as bitcoin briefly slips below $80,000
items.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $773 million on Thursday and Friday after three days of net inflows.

items.title: CoinDCX confirms $16 million loss from retired wallets
items.summary: CEO Sumit Gupta had told X users on Wednesday that early reports of a breach sounded like a false alarm.

items.title: Pump.fun's biggest winners may be impossible to copy as $752 million study exposes hidden trading gap
items.summary: Bitquery's transfer-aware analysis shows why a large address gain can conceal an acquisition a follower cannot reproduce.

items.title: Arthur Hayes exits crypto trading positions as analysts track $26 million in sales
items.summary: Arthur Hayes has exited Maelstrom's directional crypto positions, tracking about $26 million in token sales including ETH, ENA, UNI.

items.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
items.summary: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.
